hermes_surfaces.boundary: Packages a profile as a Git repository excluding memory/session/auth state; distributions unsigned by default; Git-ref pinning documented as planned, not shipped.
hermes_surfaces.evidence_ref: tests/hermes_cli/test_profile_distribution.py; distribution docs at peeled release commit

hermes_surfaces.boundary: Continuation/completion judge is an auxiliary model; contracts improve evidence expectations but do not replace deterministic or human disposition.
hermes_surfaces.evidence_ref: tests/hermes_cli/test_goals.py; goals docs at peeled release commit

hermes_surfaces.boundary: Guardrail against honest-but-wrong behavior; not a sandbox against a deliberately adversarial process.
hermes_surfaces.evidence_ref: tests/tools/test_approval_deny_rules.py; security docs at peeled release commit

hermes_surfaces.boundary: Auxiliary-model judgment and operator policy, not deterministic authorization; suggestions do not become enterprise policy without owner ratification.
HMAC signature present only when a secret is configured; entries without a secret delivered unsigned and flagged.
Native credential-injection/egress infrastructure for the Docker backend; not wired into Modal, Daytona, SSH, or Singularity; does not replace OS/container isolation.
Hermes documentation identifies isolated backends as the load-bearing boundary against adversarial execution; B07 must verify the selected backend and host boundary.
hermes_surfaces.evidence_ref: documented requirement in security docs; focused suite did not directly test the selected backend/host boundary

hermes_surfaces.boundary: Management-convenience boundary against a normal user; malformed managed files logged and ignored; environment-based escape remains possible.
Durable SQLite coordination and per-board separation; tenants documented as a soft filter; records are operational state, not independently controlled immutable audit.
Selects/ranks an underlying provider for a requested model; does not choose a model/configuration based on task outcome or risk.
Availability recovery for rate limits, overload, auth failures, connection errors; fallback may change provider/model and reset prompt caches; turn-scoped; not adaptive task routing.
Explicit main/auxiliary model and effort configuration supported; v0.20 does not establish the policy resolver that hides these choices from ordinary users.
hermes_surfaces.evidence_ref: configured-provider-routing test; configuration docs at peeled release commit

hermes_surfaces.boundary: Proves only the named clean-tag code paths; does not establish that the installed gateway uses that source tree or can execute a reference job.
Observation belongs to the dirty/divergent installed topology; supplies no exact-tag conformance or end-to-end job evidence.
hermes_surfaces.evidence_ref: installed hermes status readback reporting the gateway running

hermes_surfaces.boundary: No service start/stop, production message, or reference job performed; B07 must prove its selected gateway/backend path.
No sufficient first-party immutable enterprise packet/custody surface identified; independently controlled store required before immutable/audit-reliance language.
hermes_surfaces.evidence_ref: scoped CLI/docs/source review plus named tests

hermes_surfaces.boundary: Auth/spend is a separate authority; cost stays NOT_RUN, never estimated or invented.
No operational conclusion; may be mapped later only with their own scoped proof.
hermes_surfaces.surface: A2A, voice, and other non-reference release surfaces
